cohort: 100 women with alive singleton pregnancy who underwent VBAC in a tertiary referral hospital in Jordan, excluding those with multiple gestation, congenital fetal anomalies, intrauterine fetal death, severe extragenital pathology, and pregnancy complications.
finding: 94% of women reported high satisfaction with VBAC, primarily citing faster recovery (45%) and less pain (28%) as reasons.
mod_finding: Most women expressed high satisfaction with their VBAC experience.
